speaker: NARRATOR
text: [excited, hushed] What if you had... admin commands? In real life?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] You type it in the chat... and it just... happens.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [fast, playful] Your dad is in orbit. Your granny is faster than sound. And your cat... is the size of a building.

speaker: YOU
text: [nervous laugh] Okay. Okay! I can fix this. Un... fly... everyone...

speaker: YOU
text: [panicked] Permission DENIED?! But I'm the admin!

speaker: ADMIN
text: [booming, echoing] No. [pause] I am.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] Yeah. Things got a little... out of hand. [pause] Let's go back to Monday.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [storyteller] This is you. Twelve years old. Totally normal. [pause] Maybe a little... too normal.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You get picked last in gym. Every time. Even after the kid with the broken arm.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: In every obby, you die on the first jump. [pause] Even in "Easy Obby for Babies."

speaker: YOU
text: [frustrated] That lava came out of NOWHERE!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] It was the floor. The whole floor was lava. It said so in the name.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: At home, there's Dad. He works from home. Mostly by asking if people can hear him.

speaker: DAD
text: [loud, into the headset] Can you hear me now? [pause] How about now? [pause] NOW?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: There's Mom. She runs the whole house with sticky notes.

speaker: MOM
text: [cheerful, firm] Room. Clean. Today. [pause] I put it on a sticky note, so it's official.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: There's Granny. She is ninety-one, and she still drives to the store... at four miles an hour.

speaker: GRANNY
text: [sweet, slow] I like to... enjoy... the journey, sweetie.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And there's Pancake. The laziest cat in the world. He moves twice a day. [pause] Both times to sit on your keyboard.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: At school, there's Zoe. Your best friend. She knows everything about computers... and she's not afraid to tell you.

speaker: ZOE
text: [sarcastic] You wrote your password on a sticky note. On your monitor. Facing the window.

speaker: YOU
text: [defensive] It's a SECRET sticky note!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And then... there's Brick.

speaker: BRICK
text: [slow, smug] Lunch money. [pause] Also your cookie. [pause] Also your OTHER cookie.

speaker: YOU
text: [trying to be brave] No! [pause] ...Okay. Here. Have both cookies.

speaker: ZOE
text: [deadpan] Very brave. Very strong. [pause] Truly a legend.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: At night, you dream about being someone else. Someone strong. Someone fast. [pause] Someone who never gets picked last.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [sighs] Yeah. It was a normal Monday. [pause] Until the garage sale.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: On the way home, you see a garage sale you've never seen before. On a street you've never seen before.

speaker: YOU
text: [reading] "Server Street"? [pause] Since when do we have a Server Street?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And a very old man... who looks at you like he's been waiting.

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [creaky, mysterious] Ahh. Finally. [pause] You'll want the laptop.

speaker: YOU
text: [confused] I didn't say anything.

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [mysterious] One dollar. No refunds. [pause] And no questions.

speaker: YOU
text: Why does it say "do not type"?

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [smiling] That was a question.

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [whispers] Oh, and one more thing... [pause] It's not a game.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You turn around to get your dollar... and the whole garage sale is gone.

speaker: YOU
text: [nervous] Cool. Cool cool cool. [pause] Totally normal neighborhood.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: At home, the laptop has no apps. No games. Just one black screen... that knows your name.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [calm, robotic] Admin panel loaded. Welcome... you.

speaker: YOU
text: [whispers] It knows my username.

speaker: YOU
text: [whispers] Pancake. Not now. [pause] This is a very spooky moment.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: So you do what anyone would do. You type "help."

speaker: SYSTEM
text: Available commands: Fly. Speed. Size. Jail. Teleport. God mode. Noclip. Freeze. [pause] Kick.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [laughs] Admin commands. Like in a game. [pause] So, as a joke... you type: "fly me."

speaker: YOU
text: [shocked, then excited] I'm— I'm FLYING! I'm actually— [bonk] OW. Ceiling. There's a ceiling.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The next morning... you start testing.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Granny has been making one pancake. For forty minutes.

speaker: YOU
text: [whispers, typing] Speed... Granny.

speaker: GRANNY
text: [very fast, delighted] Oh my! Oh my! I made four hundred pancakes, sweetie! Want to go to the store? I'll drive!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [worried] Granny wanted to drive. At nine hundred miles an hour.

speaker: YOU
text: [quickly] Un-speed Granny! UN-SPEED GRANNY!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Next... the cat.

speaker: YOU
text: Size... Pancake... [pause] ten.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [panicked] Ten was too much. Ten was VERY much.

speaker: YOU
text: Size Pancake ONE! ONE!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Then you got hungry. But the fridge was SO far away.

speaker: YOU
text: [lazy] Teleport me... to the fridge.

speaker: YOU
text: [muffled] ...I said TO the fridge. Not IN the fridge.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And Dad. Dad was in a very important meeting.

speaker: DAD
text: [into the headset] Can you hear me now? Sir? Sir, can you—

speaker: YOU
text: [whispers, mischievous] Fly... Dad.

speaker: BOSS
text: [confused, on the call] Dave... are you... outside? Are you... above a tree?

speaker: DAD
text: [panicking, then pretending] I'm— I'm working from... the sky office! [pause] Can you hear me now?

speaker: BOSS
text: [amazed] Yes! Perfectly! [pause] First time in three years!

speaker: YOU
text: God mode. Me.

speaker: MOM
text: [confused] Why... won't my sticky notes stick?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You called Zoe. She was there in four minutes.

speaker: ZOE
text: [stunned, then serious] That's a real admin panel. Like, a REAL one. For... real life.

speaker: ZOE
text: [fast, explaining] In games, admins can do anything. Fly. Teleport. Ban people. They're basically... the boss of the server.

speaker: YOU
text: [slowly realizing] So I'm the boss... of real life?

speaker: ZOE
text: [serious] Listen to me. Admin panels have logs. Every command gets saved. Somebody, somewhere... can see what you type.

speaker: YOU
text: [cocky] Relax. What could possibly go wrong?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [ominous] Famous last words.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The next day, you take the laptop to school.

speaker: BRICK
text: [slow, smug] Move, noob. Lunch money.

speaker: YOU
text: [smirks, typing] Jail... Brick.

speaker: BRICK
text: [confused] Hey! Who put a CAGE on me?!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [proud] For the first time ever, Brick was the one who couldn't move.

speaker: YOU
text: Teleport me... to the front of the line.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Gym class. The mile run.

speaker: YOU
text: [whispers] Speed me.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You ran the mile in zero point three seconds. [pause] Your shoes did not survive.

speaker: COACH
text: [stunned] That's... a new world record. [pause] Also... where are your shoes?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Math test. You didn't study.

speaker: YOU
text: [typing] Noclip... me.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Noclip lets you walk through walls. [pause] It does NOT let you choose which wall.

speaker: PRINCIPAL
text: [slow, unimpressed] Young man. [pause] Did you just walk through my wall?

speaker: YOU
text: [nervous] ...No? [pause] Noclip... me... AWAY!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: By lunch... you were the most popular kid in school.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Everybody wanted a command. And you said yes. To everybody.

speaker: KID
text: [excited] Make me fly! [pause] No, wait, make me GIANT! [pause] No, wait, BOTH!

speaker: ZOE
text: [worried] Stop. Please. The logs. Somebody is going to notice.

speaker: YOU
text: [laughs] Zoe. Relax. Nobody reads the logs.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [whispers] Somebody... reads the logs.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Saturday. You decide to think bigger.

speaker: YOU
text: [excited] Fly... ALL!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The whole town took off. Including the mailman. Including a bus. [pause] Including a guy who was in the bath.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Then you wanted to make Pancake big again. Just a little. [pause] But you made a typo.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [calm] Command: size... all cats. One hundred.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [stunned] Every cat in the city. [pause] One hundred times bigger.

speaker: YOU
text: [laughing, drunk on power] I'm the king of the city! [pause] I'm the ADMIN OF EVERYTHING!

speaker: ZOE
text: [alarmed] Your log is nine thousand lines long! Somebody is DEFINITELY reading it!

speaker: ANCHOR
text: [dramatic] Breaking news! The city is flying! Grandmas are breaking the sound barrier! And a giant cat is sitting... on the mayor.

speaker: ANCHOR
text: [worried] Experts are asking one question. [pause] Who is doing this?

speaker: YOU
text: [nervous, typing fast] Okay! I'll fix it! Un-fly all! Size all cats... one!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cold] Permission denied. [pause] Permission denied. [pause] Your admin rights... are under review.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [hushed] And that's when the sky... cracked.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Out of the crack came... a chat message. [pause] The biggest chat message you've ever seen.

speaker: ADMIN
text: [booming] Who. Gave you. Admin?

speaker: YOU
text: [tiny voice] ...A garage sale?

speaker: ADMIN
text: [booming] You flew a bus. You jailed a child. You made one hundred thousand cats... GIANT.

speaker: ADMIN
text: [booming] Your log is longer... than my beard.

speaker: YOU
text: [nervous] In my defense... the cats look really happy.

speaker: ADMIN
text: [cold, booming] Un-fly. All.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Everyone fell at the same time. [pause] Lucky for them... cats are VERY good at catching things.

speaker: ADMIN
text: [booming] And now... you. [pause] Kick.

speaker: YOU
text: [panicked] No no no— God mode! GOD MODE ME!

speaker: ADMIN
text: [surprised, then angry] You... dare... use god mode... against an ADMIN?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [hushed] And that's how the first admin battle in history began.

speaker: ADMIN
text: [booming] Freeze.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: He froze you solid.

speaker: GRANNY
text: [very fast, cheerful] Hold still, sweetie! Granny's got a hair dryer!

speaker: YOU
text: [teeth chattering] Th-thanks, Granny! Teleport... me... away!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You teleported to the desert. He was there. [pause] To the ocean. He was there. [pause] To the top of a mountain. [pause] He was there... with a snack.

speaker: ADMIN
text: [calm] Teleport is my command. [pause] I invented it.

speaker: YOU
text: [typing fast] Jail... Admin!

speaker: ADMIN
text: [calm] Un-jail me. [pause] Jail YOU.

speaker: YOU
text: [frustrated] Un-jail me! [pause] Jail you! [pause] UN-JAIL ME!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] This went on for eleven minutes.

speaker: YOU
text: [typing furiously] Fine! Size me... one hundred!

speaker: ADMIN
text: [unimpressed] Size me... one thousand.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] He always had a bigger number.

speaker: DAD
text: [heroic] Nobody messes with my kid! [pause] Can you hear me now?!

speaker: ADMIN
text: [annoyed, booming] Yes! I can hear you! Everybody can hear you!

speaker: ZOE
text: [focused] I'm in his logs! He's not a program... he's a PERSON. He's typing from somewhere REAL!

speaker: YOU
text: [determined] Then I'm going there. [pause] Teleport me... to the Admin!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [warning] Warning. Battery... three percent.

speaker: YOU
text: [shouting] TELEPORT ME TO THE ADMIN!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You land in a small, warm room. Full of screens. Every screen... a different city. Every city... live.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And in the big chair... is a very old man. [pause] The old man from the garage sale.

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [tired, gentle] Ah. You found the server room. [pause] Sit down. Would you like some tea?

speaker: YOU
text: [stunned] YOU'RE the Admin?! You SOLD me the laptop!

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [chuckles] Every hundred years, I give the panel to one person. To see what they do with it.

speaker: YOU
text: [confused] Every hundred YEARS? How old ARE you?

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [proud] I've been the admin since the very first player joined. [pause] A very confused dinosaur.

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [sighs] Most people want to fly. Be fast. Be big. Win.

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [chuckles] One fellow in nineteen sixty-four made himself nine feet tall. [pause] He couldn't fit through any doors. He was very sad.

speaker: YOU
text: [quiet] ...That's exactly what I did.

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [gentle] I know. I read the logs. [pause] Every single one.

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [kind] And you never once typed a command... to help somebody else.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [quiet] And he was right.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [calm] Battery... one percent.

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [gentle] Now I'll type "undo all." Everything goes back. Including you.

speaker: YOU
text: [urgent] Wait! [pause] Let me fix it. Myself. One by one.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: So you go back. [pause] With the old man's spare charger. And a cup of tea.

speaker: YOU
text: [careful] Size... all cats... one.

speaker: YOU
text: Un-fly... the bus.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You bring back every flying thing. Every giant thing. Every Granny. [pause] Well. Almost every Granny.

speaker: GRANNY
text: [delighted] Leave me fast, sweetie! I've never been early before!

speaker: MOM
text: [touched] A sticky note? [pause] From YOU? [pause] Oh, it's official now.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And then... Brick.

speaker: BRICK
text: [quiet, embarrassed] ...Are you gonna leave me in here?

speaker: YOU
text: [softly] Un-jail Brick. [pause] Hey. Why do you always take my lunch?

speaker: BRICK
text: [small, sad] ...Because then you have to talk to me. [pause] Nobody else does.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [softly] Oh.

speaker: YOU
text: [warm] You know you could just... sit with us?

speaker: BRICK
text: [hopeful, gruff] ...Can I still have the cookie?

speaker: YOU
text: [laughs] HALF the cookie.

speaker: BRICK
text: [smiling for the first time] ...Deal.

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [warm] One last thing. The panel can keep one command for you. Forever. Any command you want.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You could be fast forever. Big forever. Never picked last again.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You think about it... for a long time.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [calm] Admin rights... removed. [pause] Thanks for playing.

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [proud, warm] Hm. [pause] In two thousand years... you're only the second person to type that.

speaker: YOU
text: [curious] Who was the first?

speaker: OLDMAN
text: [winks] Me.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The next morning, everything is normal. [pause] Mostly.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You still get picked last in gym. [pause] Except now Brick is team captain. [pause] And he picks you first.

speaker: DAD
text: [into the headset] Can you hear me now? [pause] ...I miss the sky office.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Granny is still fast. She's never been late again. [pause] She also walks to the store... faster than the car.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Zoe checks your monitor every day.

speaker: ZOE
text: [deadpan] Your password sticky note is still facing the window.

speaker: YOU
text: [proud] Yeah. But now it says "nice try."

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And Pancake still sits on your keyboard. [pause] But now... when he does...

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [calm] Command accepted.

speaker: YOU
text: [whispers, horrified] ...PANCAKE.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] The panel didn't keep one command. [pause] It kept one admin.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warm, to camera] So... if YOU had admin commands... what would you type first? Tell us in the comments!

speaker: YOU
text: [to camera] And remember: with great commands... comes great... [pause] cat problems.

speaker: YOU
text: [panicked, turning around] Pancake! Put. The laptop. DOWN!
